notes:
Background: Stratoscribe builds an in-product analytics assistant and a snippet search product for PMs and data teams. They currently call several embeddings + chat LLM providers via a simple proxy; cost has become primary pain point as usage ramps. Mid-market with clear enterprise aspirations (SSO, audit logs).

Sales/eng snapshot:
- Qualified late Jan. First hosted API demo 2026-01-28 (Avery + Diego). Good fit for hosted to start — liked streaming + function calling.
- Demo feedback: accuracy fine; main concern is per-token cost for large-scale embeddings + conversational history.
- Feb 10: delivered dedicated sizing worksheet; flagged 100 qps peak for search+chat combined (95th). They want <150ms P95 for chat.
- Security: SOC2 present, legal requests residency notes. VPC option required for Dedicated evaluation.

POC / Evaluation plan:
- Agreed: two-phase eval. Phase 1 (hosted API pilot) to validate latency and feature fit (2 weeks). Phase 2 (dedicated capacity sizing + pricing) if pilot meets latency & quality.
- Cost optimization workshop booked 2026-03-09 (workshop led by Diego + Redwood Optimize team). Agenda covered batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization tradeoffs.

Workshop outcomes (notes):
- Batching: suggested dynamic batching windows for search workloads; estimated 25-35% token-cost reduction without impacting P95 if small batch delay (10-20ms). Stratoscribe ok to accept tiny latency delta for background reranking.
- Caching: demoed prefix cache for conversational flows; suggested per-user 1.5MB active KV cache sizing. Expected hit-rate 18-22% on product tips flows -> ~12% average token reduction.
- Quantization profiles: Redwood ran quick quantization sensitivity on their baseline model (open LLM) — 8-bit Q4f16 reduced GPU cost ~40% with negligible quality delta on retrieval-augmented prompts; Stratoscribe’s ML lead asked for 2-week A/B on response quality.
- Unit economics: Diego walked through per-conversation unit cost model (embeddings + chat + rerank). With batching + cache + Q4 pre-commit, projected effective token cost reduction 45-55% for high reuse paths.

Customer quotes / signals:
- CTO (Maya Lindstrom): "If we can hit the numbers you showed for unit cost, Dedicated makes sense. We need deterministic pricing for sales motion."
- Head of ML (Ravi Kapoor): "We will run the quantized A/B on 2k eval prompts — want to ensure no regressions on hallucination-sensitive tasks."

Actions & items in CRM:
- Deliver dedicated proposal with sizing & predictable cost ladder (Avery). Target deliver by 2026-03-18.
- Set up A/B job for quantized model and send scripts (Diego).
- Legal: pre-send SOC2 + VPC architecture note (Leah to coordinate).
- Internal pricing: they asked for 12-month reserved capacity scenarios + burst pricing.

POC metrics they care about:
- P95 chat latency < 150ms (95th), throughput 100 qps steady-state, embedding 200 qps batch background.
- Embedding cost per 1k vectors target < $0.35 (effective after optimizations).
- Quality gates: top-1 factual accuracy on retrieval prompts drop < 1.5% vs baseline.

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-12 call to walk pricing deck + reserve vs burst models.
- Start quantization A/B in infra sandbox.

CRM tone: pragmatic, metric-driven. Customer prioritizes unit economics and predictable pricing. They are likely to choose Dedicated if the 2-week POC validates cost + SLOs and legal signs off on VPC terms.
